newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech 4-week T-bill auction gross yield 18.5 pct.
newsitem.headline: Czech 4-week T-bill auction gross yield 18.5 pct.

text.p: Gross yield in an auction of four-week Czech treasury bills was 18.5 percent, down from 25 percent at the last such auction one week ago, the Czech National Bank (CNB) said on Thursday.
The CNB added that the auction was heavily undersubscribed. Out of 15 billion crowns worth of bills on offer, only 3.4 billion were sold.
"The remainder was bought by the Finance Ministry for its portfolio," the CNB said.
